subject: Assigning invoice ownership & VAT responsibility — Tidal Analytics acquisition
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Assigning invoice ownership & VAT responsibility — Tidal Analytics acquisition

Team,

As we prepare for the Tidal acquisition billing consolidation, we need to lock down who owns each set of outstanding invoices and which legal entity will be responsible for VAT on each item. Key constraints:
- Final invoice run for legacy account is scheduled for 2026-10-15 local (we can move if ops objects).
- Any invoices issued for EU customers must show the acquiring entity and VAT ID per Tidal's guidance.
- Autopay for the legacy Tidal account must be disabled before the 10/15 run; we should route future invoices to the new remit.

Please take action on the following:
1) Marissa — produce a mapping of outstanding invoices (by invoice #) to the new remit entity and note VAT treatment (reverse-charge vs. VAT charged). I started a CSV with the invoice rollforward attached.
2) Lauren — coordinate with Finance Ops to open the account-change ticket and schedule any bank/ACH updates; share timeline and an owner.
3) I will draft the short billing addendum for signatures and send to Anna at Tidal for the remit/name changes.

Attaching: final_invoices_rollforward.csv, vat_ownership_matrix.xlsx

Goal: confirm owners + remit instructions by EOD 2026-10-06 so we can finalize the 10/15 run.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Assigning invoice ownership & VAT responsibility — Tidal Analytics acquisition

Thanks, Dylan — draft plan below.

Proposed schedule and owners:
- 10/04: Marissa to complete invoice -> remit entity mapping (see attached collection_plan.md).
- 10/05: Lauren to open Finance Ops ticket and request autopay disable for legacy account (owner: Lauren).
- 10/06: Legal to review one-page billing addendum (I will loop in Legal).
- 10/08: Send addendum to Tidal for signature (DocuSign link in my follow-up).
- 10/15: Final legacy invoice run, after confirming autopay off.

Notes / actions:
- I added a column in the CSV for "preferred payment method after transition" — bank transfer vs ACH.
- We should avoid issuing credit memos in the cutover window unless necessary; try to net in the final run.
- I'll confirm whether any legacy invoices originate from older contracts that explicitly require billing to "Tidal Systems Ltd" vs the new holding entity.

Attachment: collection_plan.md

Marissa
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Cc: finance@tidalanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:30:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Assigning invoice ownership & VAT responsibility — Tidal Analytics acquisition

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the heads up. We completed a reconciliation and can provide the remit details for the invoices that should be moved to the acquirer. Summary below:

- Invoices to be assigned to: Tidal Analytics Holdings Ltd
  VAT ID: PL987654321
  Remit address (EU): ul. Kwiatowa 12, 00-175 Warsaw, Poland
  Bank (EUR): Bank Polska — IBAN: PL60 1020 1026 0000 0422 2126 5412

- Invoices that remain with legacy entity (Tidal Systems Ltd) until 2026-12-31: INV-1023, INV-1030 (these have onboarding credits that need to be honored)
- Please do not change the payment instructions for closed invoices (up to and including INV-1008).

We have attached our internal list and a signed mandate form for the new remit. We also prepared a one-page billing addendum that updates the remit and VAT treatment; Anna Kowalski will sign once you send the DocuSign.

DocuSign link: https://docsend.example.com/billing-addendum-7893
Internal contact: Anna Kowalski, Head of Finance, Tidal Analytics (anna.kowalski@tidalanalytics.com)

Let us know when you have the change request submitted to your Finance Ops and the ticket number so we can track.

Best,
Anna

Subject: Re: Assigning invoice ownership & VAT responsibility — Tidal Analytics acquisition

Anna — thanks, that is exactly what we needed. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Marissa: will finalize the invoice->entity mapping and update the CSV by EOD 10/06.
- Lauren: please create the Finance Ops ticket to disable legacy autopay and update the remit per Anna's bank details. Please paste the ticket here when created.
- Legal & I will finish the billing addendum and push DocuSign before 10/08.

Requests for Tidal:
1) Please confirm whether the two invoices you flagged to remain with the legacy entity (INV-1023, INV-1030) should be excluded from the final 10/15 run or simply posted but paid to the legacy remit.
2) If anyone on your side can sign the addendum today we can accelerate the timeline — I will send the DocuSign now.

I opened a tracking ticket in our systems: BILL-1284 (Updating remit & VAT owner for Tidal acquisition). See: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/BILL-1284

Anna, I will follow up after we get the ticket number from Lauren confirming autopay is off.

Thanks everyone — small set of coordinated steps and we should be done.

Dylan
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
